tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection
tickets.text: Prepare a care‑cost runway projection for Helena Cloudpuddle and Martin Cloudpuddle comparing the current 32‑hour weekly aide schedule at $38 per hour with a higher‑coverage scenario, and indicate when cash reserves would require increased withdrawals from their $615,000 taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach
tickets.text: Document a family caregiver reimbursement approach for Helena Cloudpuddle that separates gifts, wages, and shared household costs, reflecting Lila Cloudpuddle’s reduced clinic hours and weekday transportation and medication supervision support.
tickets.evidence: Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision, and Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Obtain long-term care claim materials
tickets.text: Obtain the full long‑term care policy contract, claim packet, and elimination‑period instructions for Martin Cloudpuddle’s policy with Amber Teapot Life Insurance, as the premium notice alone is insufficient for the claim file.
tickets.evidence: For long-term care claim file materials, Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile home-care invoice amounts
tickets.text: Reconcile the billed aide hours shown in Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal with Helena Cloudpuddle’s calendar and aide sign‑in sheet to determine the correct home‑care invoice amount for planning assumptions.
tickets.evidence: Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal shows more billed aide hours for the first service week than Helena’s calendar and aide sign-in sheet, so the home-care invoice amount is not ready for planning assumptions; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-03.

tickets.title: Prepare financial questions for care conference
tickets.text: Prepare financial questions and affordability figures for the upcoming rehab team care conference to address home therapy authorization and daily supervision for Martin Cloudpuddle.
tickets.evidence: The rehab team set a near-term care conference to review home therapy authorization and daily supervision, and Helena wants financial questions and affordability figures ready for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-08.
